root_text:
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a highly contagious virus that affects people of all ages.

Prevention is key:
Wash your hands frequently
Avoid close contact with infected individuals

#HMPV #StayProtected #PublicHealth #HealthAwareness htt
